session_title.content: Implement hotness scoring for hyphae recall ranking

current_state.content: Implementation complete. access_count increment and hotness blend merged into memory_store.rs recall path. All tests passing.

task_and_goals.content:
- [x] Add access_count increment on recall
- [x] Implement sigmoid/decay blend formula
- [x] Add HYPHAE_HOTNESS_ALPHA and HYPHAE_HOTNESS_HALF_LIFE_DAYS config vars
- [ ] Cap visualization for hotness distribution (deferred)

key_facts_and_decisions.content:
- alpha=0.15, half_life_days=7.0 chosen as defaults; configurable via env
- Blend is additive: final = similarity*(1-alpha) + hotness*alpha
- access_count already exists in memories table (no migration needed)

files_and_context.content:
- hyphae/crates/hyphae-store/src/store/memory_store.rs — recall scoring path
- hyphae/crates/hyphae-core/src/memory.rs — Memory struct
- hyphae/crates/hyphae-store/src/schema.rs — confirmed access_count column exists

errors_and_corrections.content: - cargo test failed initially: missing import for `f32::ln`. Fixed by using `(1.0_f32 + x).ln()` — log1p not available as a method in stable Rust without explicit cast.

open_issues.content:
- Cap dashboard hotness chart is deferred to a separate handoff
- Multi-process access_count increment is not atomic (acceptable for single-host hyphae)
